systems_changed.change_summary: The flat 'behind on net worth' bonus souls are removed from hero-kill and Rift bounties, comeback bounties are trimmed in general, and 70% of the removed value is rerouted through tick gold to the two lowest-net-worth players. Losing lane no longer prints a lump of catch-up souls when you land a kill.
driving_changes: Removed a fixed amount of extra bonus souls you would get for being behind even a very slightly amount in net worth for both hero kill bounties as well as Unstable Rift bounties
Slightly reduced comeback bounties in general

A portion of the comeback souls earned by players above enemy teams average net worth is instead distributed via the tick gold system that is given to the lowest 2 players (70% of the extra comeback value goes to them)
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Comebacks now come from sustained econ trickle to the genuinely poor, not from one lucky kill on the fed enemy. Being ahead is stickier; a single teamfight can no longer flip a 15k deficit.

systems_changed.change_summary: Guardian bounty +10% and Walker bounty +5%, but the share that goes to nearby heroes drops from 30% to 25% (rest split across all six players). Objectives are worth more overall, but the individual who last-hits or sits on them pockets less.
driving_changes: Share for objectives bounty to nearby heroes reduced from 30% to 25% (the remaining gets split between all 6 players)
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Taking structures is still the primary snowball engine and now pays the whole team a bit more, which rewards coordinated early pushes and discourages the solo split-pusher farming a lane of towers alone.

systems_changed.change_summary: Respawn at 20 minutes rises 35s->38s (late-game max values unchanged). Deaths in the mid-game window cost more map time.
driving_changes: Respawn Time at 20 minutes increased from 35s to 38s (does not affect the max values later on, just a little higher earlier)
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Small but in the same direction as the economy changes: a mid-game pick converts into a real objective window, so aggressive tempo teams profit more from kills than from farming.

systems_changed.change_summary: Parry now pauses reload instead of resetting it, and parrying mid-dash cancels the dash and momentum to parry on the spot; stuns pause reload rather than restarting it; dashes and light melee no longer pause gun cycle time.
driving_changes: Parrying while doing a regular dash will now cancel the dash (and momentum) and parry on the spot
Getting stunned now pauses your reload rather than restarting it
Dashes and light melee's no longer pause your gun's cycle time (this is a general change that affects high-cycle time weapons the most like Silver or Abrams)
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Net gun-DPS goes up for everyone but disproportionately for high-cycle-time weapons that weave dashes/melee between shots. Defensive parry is smoother but the dash-cancel is a small mobility tax on reactive parries; overall this raises sustained gun-carry output in skirmishes.

systems_changed.change_summary: Every move slow cut ~20% and ground-dash slows cut ~10%, but slows now apply 35% of their value to air drag. Kiting is easier on the ground; flyers get dragged out of the sky.
driving_changes: All move slow values reduced by ~20% globally
All ground dash slows reduced by ~10% globally
Slows now also affect air drag by 35% of the slow value (convar citadel_enable_slows_affect_air_drag to toggle the slow drag behavior on and off)
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Ground chases and escapes are more survivable, so slow-as-utility (Slowing Hex, Bola-style effects) loses some raw lockdown but gains a new anti-air use. Flyers and anyone reliant on air mobility are hit by an entirely new penalty vector.

systems_changed.change_summary: Underground-tunnel breakables spawn at 5m instead of 3m and respawn at 5m instead of 3m. The early 'free farm' window in the tunnels is pushed back and thins out.
driving_changes: Breakables in the underground tunnels initial spawn time increased from 3m to 5m
Breakables in the underground tunnels respawn rate increased from 3m to 5m
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Slightly less early neutral souls available, which tightens the early econ curve and further discourages passive farm-heavy openings in favor of lane pressure.

tempo_shift.why: Every systems lever points one way: comeback souls removed, objective bounties up, respawns longer, and early neutral farm delayed, so winning lane and converting kills into structures is now the dominant path. The Rift resist curve (10% +1%/min) makes early Rift fights real fights rather than a scaled comeback button.

archetype_effects.why: Dashes/light melee no longer pause gun cycle time and stuns/parry pause rather than reset reload, raising sustained weapon DPS, most for high-cycle-time guns (Silver, Abrams).
Comeback souls gutted plus lower early Rift resist and higher mid-game respawns remove the safety net that let farm-heavy scalers stall into a flip.
Tempo shift rewards early kills and picks, and the global slow reduction eases ground chases and escapes, though new air-drag slows punish air-entry versions.
Removed comeback bounties and delayed tunnel farm mean a won lane keeps its lead instead of feeding the enemy a catch-up payout.
Objective bounties are up but the nearby-hero share fell 30%->25%, so tower-taking pays the team more but the solo pusher personally less; roughly a wash.
Slows now affect air drag by 35%, creating a new anti-air penalty for flyers and airborne poke that ground-based poking doesn't face.
Global slow reduction plus longer enemy respawns make diving and holding space more rewarding, and tanks are the natural buyers of the strong objective-push timing.
Parry pausing reload and the dash-cancel give reactive defense a small edge against burst windows, offset by new anti-air slow utility; net roughly flat.
Spirit carries are typically scaling-oriented and lose the comeback and Rift-safety levers the patch removed, in line with the general anti-scaling tilt.
Respawn at 20m up to 38s and stronger objective bounties mean a good engage converts into a longer, more valuable map-time swing.
No direct systems lever here beyond the tempo shift; the healing-item trims are item-side and out of scope for this systems read.

systems.intent_read: Valve is deliberately deleting the comeback lever that made losing lane recoverable, tightening early econ (tunnel breakables, Rift resist) and paying teams for structures so that the player who wins the early game actually wins the game. The reload/parry/gun-cycle smoothing and the air-drag slow look like they're separately modernizing combat feel and clipping flyers, but both feed the same tempo-first direction.

items.summary: A -13%->-12% shred trim is cosmetic on its own, but it lands on Venator whose whole identity is 'no weak point' — removing a point of resist-shred slightly narrows his already-struggling tempo conversion (45.7% WR).

affected_heroes.why: His core resist-shred item got a point weaker, piling onto a WR that already hasn't matched his reputation.

items.summary: 9->10% resist-shred is a small number but it's on the cheap T2 early-gun item, exactly where the tempo patch wants damage online. Reinforces the win-lane-harder path rather than the super-scaling one.

affected_heroes.why: Tempo early-gun carry whose T2 shred got stronger in the meta that already favors her.
Loves the early shred but still draft-dependent and pace-sensitive.
Top-WR gun carry gets a small boost to her lane-dominant opening.
The patch's biggest winner also buys the buffed early-gun shred.
Compensates the small Weakening Headshot nerf but doesn't fix his conversion problem.
C-tier poke carry that still can't convert the early lead the item wants to create.

items.build_shift: Solidifies cheap T2 weapon shred as the default first-gun slot in the tempo meta.

items.summary: Spirit scaling 0.005->0.006% is a nudge, but anti-heal DoT gains value as the patch funnels fights into inflated-HP bruisers and tanks; it's one of the few clean answers to big health pools.

affected_heroes.why: Burn carry whose scaling gets a hair better; still out-paced by the tempo meta.
Blind-pickable bruiser with built-in anti-heal stacks another anti-heal DoT.
Gets the buff but her core problem is base stats, not this item.

items.summary: Now builds from Sprint Boots, sprint 1.5->2 and cooldown 45->37s — cheaper, faster, more uptime invis. Despite creators still calling it poor, the path change lowers the entry cost for gun carries who want a repositioning tool in a pick-heavy meta.
items.build_shift: Gains the Sprint Boots component while Veil Walker loses it — the two invis items now diverge on the same tier-3 Vitality path, and this is the cheaper of the two.

items.summary: 180->170% bounty is a small number but it stacks with the whole patch's anti-greed direction: econ items are worse when comeback souls are gone and tempo wins games, so a soul-printing buy is now a tempo tax.
14->20s duration is a real uptime gain on a niche spirit utility item, but with no clear user base in the KB this stays a fringe pickup. Low confidence on who it helps.

35% slower buildup plus spirit power 40->30 and fire rate 30->25% is a triple gut on top of July's cuts — this is the proc-carry steroid that powered the Warden Mercurial build, and it no longer pays off inside a fight's window.

affected_heroes.why: Loses his primary damage steroid on top of Mercurial Magnum and Plated Armor hits — a three-item pile-on.

items.build_shift: With slower buildup, the item wants longer fights the tempo meta no longer provides; effectively removed from the spirit-carry proc build.

items.summary: Heal per boon 0.5->0.45 and stack range 35->32m trims both throughput and uptime; on a tempo support it's a soft power cut stacked on 08-22's resist nerf.

affected_heroes.why: The patch's archetype winner takes a small item-side offset to his lane-bully sustain.

items.summary: Souls/min 18->16 is another piece of the item-side economy tightening — pure-farm econ buys lose value in the same patch that delayed tunnel breakables and cut comeback souls.

Losing the Sprint Boots component kills +2 sprint/regen, movespeed now drops when invis ends, and spirit power 10->6 — the escape-and-reposition package is gutted. It goes from auto-buy to a pick-hero-only tool.

affected_heroes.why: Loses a core enabler just as the tempo meta otherwise favors her pick play.
Compounds his Mercurial/Overflow losses — now stripped on item and hero side.

items.build_shift: No longer on the Sprint Boots path, so it competes for a Vitality slot without the mobility subsidy; Shadow Weave now inherits that component.

items.summary: 2->2.25% max-health regen is a rounding-level buff, but it's on the default survivability slot for nearly every bruiser and tank, and the patch's slower respawn/longer-fight direction makes sustained regen more valuable than burst.

affected_heroes.why: Bruiser already helped by the gun-cycle change; slight extra regen keeps him brawling.
Tank that lives in minute-one brawls the patch rewards.
Near-universal slot — anyone on Fortitude gets a tiny durability tax cut in longer fights.

items.summary: Melee heal 100+1.5->120+1.75 and 30->35% is a real sustain gain, but the bigger story is synergy: with slows now affecting air drag, its 48% slow becomes a genuine anti-air lockdown, so it reads as a CC item as much as a heal.

affected_heroes.why: Effectively a Billy item — the heal buff plus new anti-air slow feeds his already-dominant S-tier frontline.

items.build_shift: Upgrades from a melee-sustain slot to a CC/anti-air option in the same patch slows gained air-drag effect.

items.summary: 25->28% bullet+spirit lifesteal raises ceiling but the KB still calls it weak, and in a tempo meta that ends fights fast there's little window to lifesteal back — the buff doesn't address why nobody buys it.

The fix is a real balance shift, not cosmetic: it now blocks on-hit spirit damage from Mercurial Magnum, Vindicta's Flight, Wraith's Full Auto and Tesla Bullets/Capacitor — turning a defensive slot into a hard counter to mixed-damage on-hit carries.

affected_heroes.why: Mercurial Magnum on-hit spirit damage is now actually blocked — third hit to his build this patch.
Full Auto spirit damage now gets eaten, worsening her already-falling trajectory.
Flight on-hit is now counterable by a defensive pick, trimming the tempo winner's tools.

items.build_shift: Becomes the defensive answer to on-hit/mixed-damage builds, competing with generic resist slots for tank-side buyers.

items.summary: Adding +10% ultimate CDR pushes it from a generic defense item into a coordination/initiation enabler — it now wants heroes whose win condition is a big ult on a clock.

affected_heroes.why: Ult-initiator whose whole value is the AoE-CC ult; CDR makes his threat cycle faster.
Tank-carry that already buys it, now with better ult uptime on top of her other buffs.

items.build_shift: Slot stays Vitality, but the item's identity tilts from survivability toward ult-uptime — direct competition with pure CDR items.

items.summary: Damage penalty -10->-15%, souls/min 90->80, and stored souls now count toward net worth — the last clause is the killer: it interacts directly with the patch's comeback change and removes the item's whole point of hiding net worth from bounty math.
items.build_shift: Effectively unbuyable — the patch's worst item, and the clause tying stored souls to net worth is a targeted deletion of the 'lose lane, bank souls, ignore come back' pattern.

items.summary: 27->29s cooldown trims the pick-engage frequency on near-every-game pick heroes, but the global slow change cuts the other way: its slow now drags flyers out of the air, adding a new anti-air use that partially offsets the CD tax.

affected_heroes.why: Loses some uptime on her cheap pick-enabler on top of her Carbine trim.
CC-build staple gets shorter engage windows during an already-falling patch.
Loses a little CD but gains the new anti-air slow on the flyers she was buffed to punish.

items.summary: Per-boon scaling 2->1.7 caps out less late; it's the second cut in two patches to a healing-support item, softly taxing sustain supports without removing the slot.

affected_heroes.why: Healer whose item path is being progressively trimmed on top of 08-22's nerf.

items.summary: 8->7.5% current-health bonus is a nudge, but stacked on 07-28 (no longer procs off items) it's a cumulative trim to the anti-tank slot just as the patch funnels big HP pools into fights.

affected_heroes.why: Anti-tank bruiser loses a hair of his shred, though his current-HP knives carry the identity.
Small trim on a slot she relies on for the burst that the tempo meta rewards.

items.summary: DPS -25% but duration +20% trades burst healing-cut for sustained anti-heal — worse at clipping a single big burst-heal window, better at keeping tanks suppressed over a long brawl, which fits the patch's longer fights.

Rising scaler who buys it mostly as a defensive anti-heal tool.

items.summary: Base bullet scaling 0.49->0.38 and base damage 25->20% is a heavy cut — combined with the Spiritual Overflow nerf and Plated Armor fix, the Mercurial on-hit carry build it anchored is dead in one patch.

items.summary: 30->35% damage and cast range 20->25m make it a stronger spirit-amp option, but it's still cleansable, so the buff mostly helps clean engages rather than dominating. Low-confidence read — no KB user listed.
items.build_shift: Better range makes it a more viable opener for burst casters on cleansable targets.

notable_item_stories: Three econ items (Cultist Sacrifice, Trophy Collector, Golden Goose Egg) get trimmed at once — the item-side echo of the patch's anti-comeback economy, with Golden Goose Egg's net-worth clause specifically deleting the bank-and-hide pattern.
The Mercurial Magnum + Spiritual Overflow nerfs plus Plated Armor's on-hit fix form one coordinated stack that removes Warden's carry build in a single patch.

Invisibility items diverge around Sprint Boots: Shadow Weave gains the component plus a buff while Veil Walker loses it and gets stripped, so expect cheap gun-invis to rise and the pick-hero invis to fall.

Fortitude regen 2->2.25% max HP helps his near-universal bruiser slot.
Gun-carry archetype up but late-scaler archetype down — roughly a wash.
heroes.one_liner: Same balanced burn carry; item buffs don't fix the tempo meta outpacing his scaling.

indirect_reasons: Hollow Point resist-shred 9->10% buffs his core T2 gun slot.

build_changes: Lean on Echo Shard bomb over Carbine poke.

Weighted Bola now increases gravity and interrupts flying abilities (Phantom-Strike rules) — a new pick tool.
Dashes/light melee no longer pause gun cycle, directly boosting her high-cycle gun.
Boot Kick and Entangling Bola now only target heroes/objectives, removing wasted hits.
indirect_reasons: Hollow Point shred buff and Fortitude regen buff hit her core slots.
Diviner's Kevlar +10% ult CDR helps her existing buy.
Gun-carry and tank archetypes both up.
build_changes: Weighted Bola is now a core grounded-interrupt pick; build around gun-tank with Diviner's Kevlar.
heroes.one_liner: The patch's biggest winner headlined by a Phantom-Strike-style grounded Bola.

direct_reasons: Stamina cooldown 5->5.3, Light Eater spirit lifesteal 20%->18%, Dazzling Trick cd 34s->38s.
Shining Wonder radius 16.5m->15.5m, T3 bounces +8->+6, Radiant Daggers T2 +80->+70, Light Eater T3 +25->+22.
indirect_reasons: Slows now affect air drag by 35%, punishing her flying kit.
Spirit-carry archetype down with comeback/Rift levers removed.
Paige's rise and the anti-scaling tilt squeeze her slot.
heroes.one_liner: Nerfed seven ways plus air-drag slows on a flyer; drops out of A.

synthesis.size_why: It deletes a core economy mechanic (flat behind-net-worth bounty souls, 70% rerouted to tick gold for the two poorest) and adds a new one (slows now hit air drag at 35%), plus a gun-cycle/reload rework and a coordinated four-item deletion of a carry build. That is a systems rework, not tuning, despite the 'Minor Update' label and the modest hero numbers.
synthesis.headline: The comeback lever is gone: winning lane now wins the game outright, and tempo snowballers own the meta.

meta_thesis.previous: Tempo already beat scaling after the 07-30 comeback rework, with early snowballers rising and late scalers and flyers falling while the old overloaded S-tier kits sat mid.
meta_thesis.new: This patch finishes the job: the flat catch-up bounty is removed, so a fed team's lead is sticky instead of printable by one lucky kill, and a new anti-air slow vector clips flyers and airborne poke. Snowballing is now the only reliable win condition, and long-fight steroid/proc builds lose their window.
meta_thesis.why: Every systems lever points the same way as the prior thesis (comeback souls removed, objective bounties up, respawns +3s, tunnel farm delayed, air-drag slows added); the item layer completes the anti-scaler story by gutting Mercurial/Spiritual Overflow and Golden Goose Egg.

winners.why: Weighted Bola now grounds and interrupts flyers (Phantom-Strike rules) plus +3 hp/boon, sprint 1.5->2.5, and the no-pause gun-cycle change directly boosts her high-cycle gun.
Heavy Melee spirit scaling 0.3->0.45, Captivating Read CDs improved, and her lane-bully/support archetype is the exact snowball the tempo economy rewards.
Lifestrike heal and slow buffed (48% now drags flyers), Decay/Fortitude buffed — an already-dominant frontline gets sustain plus new anti-air lockdown.
More buffs (Crimson Slash heal scaling, Flying Slash 1.0->1.2) stacked on an S-tier mobile assassin in a pick-heavy patch.
Absent from the notes but the lane-bully snowball archetype is exactly what the comeback removal and higher objective bounties reward; only his Restorative Locket takes a trim.

losers.why: A four-way pile-on: Mercurial Magnum 0.49->0.38, Spiritual Overflow triple-nerf, Veil Walker stripped of Sprint Boots, and Plated Armor now blocks his on-hit spirit damage — the proc build is dead.

Nerfed seven ways (stamina, Light Eater, Dazzling Trick, Shining Wonder radius/bounces, Dagger T2) while the new 35% air-drag slow punishes her flying kit and the anti-scaling tilt removes her safety net.
Card Trick heal and resist-shred cut, Slowing Hex CD up, and Plated Armor now eats Full Auto's on-hit spirit damage — her CC and carry builds both lose a tool.
The Cube cast range 26m->20m guts his signature rescue, and Puddle Punch 21s->24s plus damage trims hit his identity; only the Goo Ball buff helps.
A C-tier poke carry the tempo meta already punishes; the new air-drag slows land on airborne poke and he has no compensation beyond a Hollow Point nudge.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The 'general' dash/no-pause gun-cycle and reload-pause changes are functionally a Silver and Abrams buff, not a neutral quality-of-life pass.
non_obvious_calls.why: Valve's own note says it matters most for high-cycle-time weapons, and Silver separately gets stat buffs; net gun-DPS rises unevenly toward those two.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Golden Goose Egg's 'stored souls count toward net worth' clause is a targeted deletion of the lose-lane-and-bank-while-ignoring-comeback pattern, not a generic econ trim.
non_obvious_calls.why: It interacts directly with the removed behind-net-worth bounty, so hiding net worth no longer dodges the system the patch just tightened.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The air-drag slow is really an anti-flyer nerf aimed at Celeste, Vindicta, and airborne poke, dressed up as a movement-feel change.
non_obvious_calls.why: Slows were cut ~20% globally yet gain a 35% air-drag vector, a penalty that only applies to airborne heroes — Celeste is separately hit seven ways.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The invisibility items have quietly swapped roles: Shadow Weave is now the cheap gun-reposition tool and Veil Walker a pick-hero-only buy.
non_obvious_calls.why: Shadow Weave gains the Sprint Boots component plus sprint/cooldown buffs while Veil Walker loses the component and movespeed-on-break, diverging on the same T3 Vitality path.

uncertainties: The win/pick snapshot is 14 days and mostly pre-patch, so every WR cited is a baseline, not a post-patch number.
Whether Silver's grounded-interrupt Bola is over-tuned or just right — no post-patch data yet.
Low-confidence hero reads (Seven, Mina, Grey Talon, Graves) rest on archetype direction rather than kit changes.
Whether Plated Armor's on-hit fix actually pulls tank-side buyers toward it or stays a niche counter-pick.
what_to_watch: Silver's pick/ban rate and WR — the clearest winner; a spike confirms the Bola-plus-stat read.
Warden's pick rate collapse and whether a pure silence-cage utility build survives.
Apollo's post-patch WR to validate the unlisted-lane-bully thesis.
Celeste's WR to confirm the air-drag plus seven-nerf stack.
Golden Goose Egg and Veil Walker pick rates to confirm the item-layer deletions landed.

verdicts.one_liner: Card Trick gutted and Plated Armor counters Full Auto; pivot to the gun build or fall behind.
verdicts.direct: Card Trick heal 75->60 and spirit scaling 0.75->0.5 plus resist-shred -8%->-7% cut her sustain and debuff; Full Auto spirit 0.03->0.045 is only a small compensation.
verdicts.indirect: Plated Armor now eats Full Auto's on-hit spirit damage — a direct counter — while Slowing Hex CD 27->29s trims CC uptime and the removed comeback bounty strips her late-scaler safety net.
build_adjustments: Stop maxing Card Trick; move those points into Full Auto.
Keep the gun build (Capacitor, Lucky Shot); the CC build lost its heal and shred.
Expect Plated Armor on tanks — don't build around Full Auto's on-hit spirit vs them.

verdicts.one_liner: Four-item pile-on kills the proc carry; only the silence-cage utility build survives.
verdicts.direct: Bullet damage/boon 0.28->0.25, fire-rate spirit scaling 0.25->0.21, Alchemical Flask range/speed -30%, Willpower T3 and debuff resist all cut — a major kit nerf.
verdicts.indirect: Mercurial Magnum 0.49->0.38, Spiritual Overflow's triple nerf, Veil Walker losing Sprint Boots, and Plated Armor blocking Mercurial on-hit together delete his proc-carry build from every side.
build_adjustments: Drop Mercurial Magnum and Spiritual Overflow; the on-hit carry core is gone.
If you stay, run the silence-cage utility build with Fortitude/survivability, not damage.

kb_update.meta_md:
# Meta state
Last patch: Minor Update - 09-16-2026 (2026-09-16)

## Thesis
Comeback is dead. With the flat behind-net-worth bounty removed and objective bounties raised, a team that wins lane holds the lead unless it throws hard; tempo beats scaling. Games are decided by early lane bullies and mobile bruisers turning a lead into objectives and picks before late-scaler steroid builds come online. Flyers, on-hit proc carries, and pure-farm econ buys lost their windows.

## Economy and systems
- Comeback bounty removed; 70% of the rerouted value goes to the two poorest players via tick gold. Fed teams now keep leads.
- Guardian bounty +10%, Walker +5%; objective share 30->25%. Respawn at 20m 35->38s.
- Unstable Rift resist is now 10% +1%/min (cap 40% at 30m), not flat 35% — early rifts are real fights.
- Slows cut ~20% globally but now apply 35% air drag; slow-as-CC and anti-air both stronger.
- Stuns/parry pause reload instead of resetting; dashes and light melee no longer break gun cycle (Silver/Abrams smoothing).
- Tunnel breakables spawn/respawn at 3m->5m, delaying early solo farm.

## Archetype standing
- Early tempo / lane bullies: up — winning lane is the win condition.
- Mobile assassins and bruisers (Yamato, Shiv, Holliday): up; picks convert.
- Tanks/frontline (Abrams, Mo & Krill, Billy): stable-to-up; Fortitude/Decay buffed.
- Late scalers (Warden, Wraith, Celeste, Pocket): down; no safety net.
- Flyers/poke (Celeste, Grey Talon, Vindicta): down via air-drag slows.
- Supports (Ivy, Paige): stable-to-up; lanes matter but healing items keep getting trimmed.
- On-hit proc carries (Warden): down; Mercurial+Overflow deleted and Plated Armor now blocks on-hit spirit.

## Watchlist
- Silver: grounded Bola interrupt + stats + gun-cycle boost; biggest winner, but her 46.7% WR is pre-patch.
- Apollo: absent from notes, best snowballer — confirm his WR.
- Warden: does a pure silence-cage build survive the four-item execution?
- Celeste: seven nerfs + air drag; confirm she drops out of A.
- Items: Golden Goose Egg and Veil Walker pick rates — are the deletions real?

## Recent history
- Minor Update - 09-16-2026: comeback souls removed; tempo wins games; Warden/Celeste/Wraith/Viscous gutted, Silver/Paige up.
- Minor Update - 08-22-2026: Celeste and healing-item tuning.
- Minor Update - 08-12-2026: McGinnis/Apollo changes.
- Minor Update - 07-30-2026: Ranked Mode added.
- Minor Update - 07-28-2026: item and hero tuning.

Seven.why: Draft-dependent gun carry: Hollow Point's shred buff sharpens his early lead, but tunnel breakables now spawn later (3m->5m) and tempo invaders punish his slow start.
Seven.notes: 09-16 (indirect): Hollow Point shred +1% is his only tailwind; tunnel farm delayed.

Vindicta.why: Tempo early-gun carry who profits from picks mattering more post-20m and from Hollow Point's shred buff; only her airborne poke is clipped by the new air-drag slows.
Vindicta.notes: 09-16 (indirect): Hollow Point 9->10% shred strengthens her lane pick.

Lady Geist.why: Tanky spirit bruiser with direct buffs (Life Drain T3 heal scaling +0.45, Essence Bomb T3 +4%) who rises as scaler peers fall; still low WR but wins fights on her ult.
Lady Geist.notes: 09-16: Life Drain T3 spirit scaling 0.3->0.45, Essence Bomb T3 26->30%.

Abrams.why: Tank initiator helped by the gun-cycle change (weave shots between punches) plus Fortitude/Decay buffs, but the anti-heal meta and a shorter ult window keep him B.
Abrams.notes: 09-16: Infernal Resilience T3 heal 8->9%; Seismic Impact T3 Unstoppable 6->5s.

Wraith.why: Gun carry who lost her safety net: Card Trick heal and resist-shred cut, Slowing Hex CD up, and Plated Armor now eats Full Auto's on-hit spirit damage. Gun build over CC.
Wraith.notes: 09-16: Card Trick heal 75->60 and spirit scaling 0.75->0.5, Diamond resist-shred -8->-7%; Full Auto spirit 0.03->0.045.

Paradox.why: Pick initiator whose Carbine quick-scope poke was trimmed (min multiplier 25->10%, no T3 scaling) and Slowing Hex CD up; still wins on the Echo Shard bomb.
Paradox.notes: 09-16: Kinetic Carbine min multiplier 25->10% and no longer scaled by T3; Slowing Hex cd 27->29s.

Dynamo.why: Ult-initiator with an AoE-CC ult that now cycles faster via Diviner's Kevlar's +10% ult CDR; the tempo meta rewards converting a won lane into picks.

Haze.why: Gun carry whose Fixation buff (headshot stacks 2->3, higher T3 scaling) plus the gun-cycle change make gun Haze the build; only Plated Armor's fix counters her on-hit.
Haze.notes: 09-16: Fixation headshot stacks 2->3 and T3 weapon scaling 0.0003->0.00035.

Holliday.why: Mobile assassin pushed to a gun-hybrid (health/boon 41->43, Crackshot T2 shred, longer lasso) and favored by pick-heavy tempo, but Veil Walker's strip removed a core enabler.
Holliday.notes: 09-16: health/boon 41->43, Crackshot T2 -6% bullet resist 5s, Bounce Pad lasso +1->+1.25s; Veil Walker now a worse slot.

Calico.why: Above-average skirmisher whose early underground farm is pushed back by the 3m->5m breakable timing; still ~50% WR on a high pick rate.
Calico.notes: 09-16 (indirect): later breakables delay her early farm.

Grey Talon.why: Poke/siege carry the tempo meta punishes; new air-drag slows clip his airborne poke and Hollow Point shred can't fix a sub-48% conversion. Low confidence.
Grey Talon.notes: 09-16 (indirect): air-drag slows hurt airborne poke; no direct compensation.

Mo & Krill.why: Underplayed frontline tank that quietly wins: Fortitude regen and Decay duration buffs suit his minute-one brawls and the tempo meta.
Mo & Krill.notes: 09-16 (indirect): Fortitude regen and Decay duration buffed.

Shiv.why: Anti-tank bruiser whose current-HP knives and alt-fire buffs shred exactly the inflated HP pools this patch funnels into fights; the Tankbuster trim is small.
Shiv.notes: 09-16: alt-fire +4% base and per-boon 0.2->0.24; Serrated Knives full-rage 3.5% current HP on impact.

Ivy.why: Support queen with only small Stone Form nerfs; still the best team-sustain and map control at high WR, though healing items keep getting trimmed around her.

Warden.why: Gun carry whose proc build (Mercurial + Spiritual Overflow) is deleted and who lost Veil Walker; bullet/boon and fire-rate scaling cut plus a 30% flask trim. Only a pure silence-cage utility build survives.
Warden.notes: 09-16: bullet/boon 0.28->0.25, fire-rate spirit 0.25->0.21, flask range/speed -30%, Willpower T3 spirit 2.7->2.1 and debuff resist 40->30%; Mercurial + Overflow + Veil Walker all hit.

Yamato.why: Mobile burst assassin buffed again (Crimson Slash T3 heal scaling +0.4, Flying Slash light-melee 1.0->1.2) atop a tempo meta that loves her Refresher/Unstoppable burst windows.
Yamato.notes: 09-16: Crimson Slash T3 +0.4 heal spirit scaling; Flying Slash light-melee 1.0->1.2.

Viscous.why: Tank/enabler whose Cube cast range 26->20m guts his signature rescue and Puddle Punch cooldown 21->24s cuts dueling; only the Goo Ball T3 scaling helps.
Viscous.notes: 09-16: Cube range 26->20m, Puddle Punch 21->24s, alt-fire growth -10%, Splatter T1 +2->+1.5m; Goo Ball T3 +0.2 spirit.

Pocket.why: Spirit cloak assassin still wants long fights the tempo meta denies; Fortitude's regen is his only item-side help and his WR stays low.
Pocket.notes: 09-16 (indirect): tempo shift further punishes his long-fight scaling.

Vyper.why: Top-WR coin-flip gun carry: Slither T3 barrier and ult cooldown trimmed, Hollow Point buffed; still 1v6s into low-CC drafts and is useless into CC-heavy comps.
Vyper.notes: 09-16: Slither T3 barrier 5->4s, Petrifying Bola cd 105->115s.

Mina.why: Mobile spirit assassin given no compensation for the tempo shift; her kit no longer converts and she needs a rework.
Mina.notes: 09-16 (indirect): no changes to a falling assassin.

Drifter.why: Blind-pickable melee bruiser with built-in anti-heal; Toxic Bullets scaling and Fortitude regen are tailwinds in a brawl-friendly patch.
Drifter.notes: 09-16 (indirect): Toxic Bullets scaling + Fortitude regen buffed.

Venator.why: Gun carry whose ult now works with Ricochet/Split Shot (real late damage), but a mid-40s WR says the no-weak-point kit still doesn't convert in tempo.
Venator.notes: 09-16: Ira Domini now works with Ricochet (all shots bounce) and Split Shot (3 bolts); Weakening Headshot -13->-12%.

Paige.why: Lane-winning support and the patch's clearest winner: heavy-melee spirit scaling 0.3->0.45, Captivating Read CD/range buffs, and the flyers she feared were nerfed. Slowing Hex is now a real anti-air slow.
Paige.notes: 09-16: heavy-melee spirit 0.3->0.45, Captivating Read T1 -11->-14s and T3 +1->+2m, Rallying Charge collision fixed.

Billy.why: Best frontline: Lifestrike heal+slow buff doubles as anti-air lockdown, and Decay/Fortitude buffs feed his minute-one brawls and AoE front-line.
Billy.notes: 09-16 (indirect): Lifestrike heal 100+1.5->120+1.75 and 30->35%; 48% slow now drags flyers.

Graves.why: Worst-scaling gun carry; health/boon 33->35 and Toxic Bullets/Fortitude buffs help, but her awful base stats still leave her permanently behind until late.

Apollo.why: Absent from notes but the archetype winner: a top early snowballer (ganks, instant clears, escape, flat damage/heal) whose tempo playstyle the economy patch rewards; only his Restorative Locket slot takes a trim.
Apollo.notes: 09-16 (indirect): tempo economy favors his lane-bully snowball; Restorative Locket trimmed.

Silver.why: Biggest winner: Weighted Bola now a grounded anti-flyer interrupt (Phantom-Strike rules), health/boon 28->31, sprint 1.5->2.5, and the gun-cycle change boosts her high-cycle gun.
Silver.notes: 09-16: Weighted Bola grounds/interrupts flyers, health/boon 28->31, sprint 1.5->2.5, Boot Kick/Entangling Bola now only hit heroes/objectives.

Celeste.why: Spirit burst carry hit seven ways (stamina, Light Eater, Dazzling Trick, Shining Wonder, Radiant Daggers) plus the air-drag slow punishing her flying kit; drops out of A.
Celeste.notes: 09-16: stamina cd 5->5.3, Light Eater 20->18% and T3 +25->+22, Dazzling Trick 34->38s, Shining Wonder 16.5->15.5m and T3 bounces +8->+6, Radiant Daggers T2 +80->+70.

Weakening Headshot.notes: 09-16: bullet resist reduction -13->-12%, a nudge. Still core on Venator, whose whole identity is 'no weak point'.

Hollow Point.notes: 09-16: bullet resist reduction 9->10%. The cheap T2 first-gun slot of the tempo meta.

Toxic Bullets.notes: 09-16: spirit scaling 0.005->0.006%. Core burn/anti-heal slot and one of the few real answers to inflated HP.

Shadow Weave.notes: 09-16: now builds from Sprint Boots, sprint 1.5->2, cooldown 45->37s. Cheaper gun-reposition tool that inherits the component Veil Walker lost.

Cultist Sacrifice.notes: 09-16: bounty 180->170%; soul-printing is a tempo tax now that comeback souls are gone.

Ballistic Enchantment.notes: 09-16: duration 14->20s; still fringe, no clear user base.

Spiritual Overflow.notes: 09-16: buildup 35% slower, spirit power 40->30, fire rate 30->25% (on top of 07-28); the Mercurial proc-carry build is dead.

Restorative Locket.notes: 09-16: heal per boon 0.5->0.45, stack range 35->32m; 08-22 spirit resist 10->8%. Still the stamina/utility buy.

Trophy Collector.notes: 09-16: souls/min 18->16; part of the soul-economy trim.

Veil Walker.notes: 09-16: no longer builds from Sprint Boots (lost +2 sprint/regen), movespeed removed when invis drops, spirit power 10->6. Now a pick-hero-only buy.

Fortitude.notes: 09-16: max-health regen 2->2.25%. The default survivability slot on almost every bruiser.

Lifestrike.notes: 09-16: melee-heal 100+1.5->120+1.75 and 30->35%; with slows now affecting air drag its 48% slow is real anti-air lockdown.

Leech.notes: 09-16: bullet+spirit lifesteal 25->28%; still weak — tempo fights end too fast to drain back.

Plated Armor.notes: 09-16 fix: now blocks on-hit spirit damage (Mercurial Magnum, Vindicta Flight, Wraith Full Auto, Tesla/Capacitor). The defensive answer to mixed-damage on-hit carries.

Diviner's Kevlar.notes: 09-16: now grants +10% Ultimate Ability CDR; tilts from generic defense to an ult-uptime enabler for initiation heroes. 07-28: spirit power +35->+40.

Golden Goose Egg.notes: 09-16: damage penalty -10->-15%, souls/min 90->80, stored souls now count toward net worth — effectively unbuyable; deletes the bank-and-hide pattern.

Slowing Hex.notes: 09-16: cooldown 27->29s; slower engage but now a real anti-air slow given the air-drag change.

Radiant Regeneration.notes: 08-22 heal on cast 70->65; 09-16 per-boon scaling 2->1.7 — cumulative nerf to healing supports.

Tankbuster.notes: 07-28 no longer procs off items; 09-16 current-health bonus 8->7.5% — cumulative trim to the anti-tank slot.

Decay.notes: 09-16: DPS -25% but duration +20% — trades burst healing-cut for sustained suppression over longer fights. Still the go-to anti-heal slot.

Mercurial Magnum.notes: 09-16: base bullet damage scaling 0.49->0.38 and base damage 25->20% — no longer a damage engine; the Mercurial+Overflow proc build has no reliable core.

Focus Lens.notes: 09-16: damage 30->35%, cast range 20->25m; still cleansable, so niche.
